title: The Man Who Left His Will on Film
writer: Nagisa Ôshima, Tsutomu Tamura, Masato Hara
actors: Kazuo Goto, Sukio Fukuoka, Kenichi Fukuda
plot: A metaphysical mystery involving a university student's camera getting stolen, and the thief then committing suicide. Looking back upon the event, the situation comes to be questioned if it happened at all.
